Two levels of play, 'senior' (for adults) and 'junior' (for children aged 3+), guarantee hours of entertainment for all. Become an expert and finish the puzzles in the shortest possible time and you will find yourself amongst the best in the world on the online leaderboard. You can also play with friends and family in the one-on-one split-screen competition mode. Your rival won't make it easy for you! Don't give up - fill an energy bar to perform a counterattack and put them in their place. Get the 3 stars in the 25 jigsaw puzzle with 7 difficulties each. This gives the game great replayability.. All this is told accompanied by beautiful drawings.

Two levels of play, 'senior' (for adults) and 'junior' (for children aged 3+), guarantee hours of entertainment for all. The mean magician Godron has stolen the book „Mathematica“ from the creator of Trillion, and has cast an evil spell over the city: a ban on mathematics. Godron wants to gain power over the whole land and transform the world according to his will. But there are the brave heroes Bernard and Celestine with their friend 2weistein who want to put a stop to Godron to keep Trillion peaceful and beautiful, and no on is ever to be afraid again! About the 2weistein games The unique and fantastic idea behind the series of 2weistein games is to train maths in a real 3D action adventure. Embedded in the tantalizing story the player has to solve maths quests or puzzles to get ahead in the game. It was developed by game specialists in cooperation with teachers and psychologists and won several prices and awards in Germany and Austria.

Protagonist Misa Isshiki is a second-year high school student. It was around the beginning of fall when her best friend said this to her, which gave her a shock.

“I don’t believe in being spirited away, so I’m alright.”

That’s right, she doesn’t believe in it. She just… feels lost because of a major distress—her career path.

This new video game from Asobo Studio sends you on an emotional journey through 14th-century France, with gameplay combining adventure, action and stealth, supported by a compelling story. Follow the young Amicia and her little brother Hugo, who face the brutality of a ravaged world as they discover their purpose to expose a dark secret. On the run from the Inquisition's soldiers, surrounded by unstoppable swarms of rats incarnating the Black Death, Amicia and Hugo will learn to know and trust each other as they struggle for their lives against all odds.

The player assumes control of Amicia and must face against both soldiers from the French Inquisition and hordes of rats that are spreading the black plague. Gameplay is largely similar to the first game, though the combat system is significantly expanded. The game features a progression system in which the player will be awarded additional skills and abilities. Stealth players will unlock skills that allow them to sneak around more efficiently, while those who prefer a more lethal approach will unlock additional combat skills. Locations are also larger, giving players additional options to progress.

The following places can be visited on the farm: The Pigsty: Home to a family of three pigs, happily romping in the mud, waiting to be stroked and given lots of food. The Stable: Abbie's beloved horse lives here, and is happy to receive any attention. The stable is also where the farmyard cat tries his luck at catching mice. Despite the presence of the horse and the cat, there are a lot of mice, which are difficult to catch. The Garden: This is where all the food grows for the animals on Abbie's farm - carrots, apples, cabbage, beets, corn, grass, strawberries and more. After the fruit and other crops have been harvested, it takes a little while until they grow back again. The scarecrow keeps thieving birds away from the crops. The Well: This is where Abbie draws water to give to the animals, for example. The powers of deduction and logic of little farmers are challenged by everyday tasks: for example, to collect water, the bucket must first be found and then used with the well. You are also able to enjoy playing together in coop mode.

games.title: Arcade Archives: Donkey Kong
games.summary: Donkey Kong is an action game released in 1981 by Nintendo. Avoid a variety of obstacles while heading through a construction site to make it to the top and rescue Lady. Use the hammer to destroy the barrels and fire coming towards you to earn more points.

games.title: Arcade Archives: Donkey Kong 3
games.summary: Donkey Kong 3 is a shooting game released by Nintendo in 1983. Take on the role of the hero Stanley, and use your Sprayer to drive away Donkey Kong and exterminate the various flower-stealing bugs that appear in the botanical garden. Get high scores with a perfect bonus by chasing off Donkey Kong and having no flowers stolen!

games.title: Arcade Archives: Donkey Kong Jr.
games.summary: Donkey Kong Jr. is an action game released by Nintendo in 1982. Donkey Kong has been captured and caged in his latest encounter with Mario. Donkey Kong Jr. is on his way to set him free! Skillfully jump and hang on to vines, avoid the enemies, get to the top, and steal the cage's key from Mario.

games.title: Arcade Archives: Excitebike
games.summary: Excitebike is a motorcycle racing game released by Nintendo in 1984. In addition to solo qualifying races, there are final races where you face off against motorcross riders. Each course has its own variety of obstacles. Use all your techniques to avoid the obstacles as you aim for first place (this is the Nintendo VS.System version, however the two player mode and track creation function are not included).

games.title: Arcade Archives: Golf
games.summary: Golf is a sports game released by Nintendo in 1984. Pay close attention to the wind direction and speed, choose the best club, and aim for the lowest score as you play across 18 holes. You can also challenge a friend in the 2 player mode.

games.title: Arcade Archives: Ice Climber
games.summary: Ice Climber is an action game released by Nintendo in 1985. Play as Popo and Nana to break apart blocks of ice with your hammer and defeat enemies that get in your way as you aim for the top of the mountain. However, only one person can catch the condor waiting at the summit. Will you work together, or try to go for it alone? It's up to you!

games.title: Arcade Archives: Mario Bros.
games.summary: Mario Bros. is an action game released by Nintendo in 1983. It's the first game that used Mario in the title. Control Mario or Luigi in order to punch the enemies coming out of pipes from below to turn them over and then defeat them. In the two-player mode, both players can choose to work together or work against each other and enjoy the game in a myriad of ways.

games.title: Arcade Archives: Pinball
games.summary: Pinball is a pinball game released by Nintendo in 1984. The rules are simple even for beginners: try to gain points without losing the ball. However, with various tricks and features, the game offers a depth that even experts can enjoy. Fans can also enjoy seeing Mario and Lady from Donkey Kong in the bonus stage!

games.title: Arcade Archives: Punch-Out!!
games.summary: Punch-Out!! is a sports-action game released by Nintendo in 1984. Watch your opponents' expressions and moves as you use a variety of punches and defensive moves on your path to become the boxing champion. The game became extremely popular with the double monitor setup, introducing intense boxing with dynamic graphics.

games.title: Arcade Archives: Sky Skipper
games.summary: Sky Skipper is a shooting action game released in 1981 by Nintendo. Dodge enemy attacks and counterattack with your bombs! Get even more points by saving the right combination of 4 animals! Don't forget to go and replenish your fuel when you run low.

games.title: Arcade Archives: Soccer
games.summary: Soccer is a sports game released by Nintendo in 1985. Play matches against the CPU in single player mode or another player in 2-player mode. Try polishing your skills in single player, then take on friends and family! Enjoy simple, but exciting gameplay in the father of all soccer games!

games.title: Arcade Archives: Super Punch-Out!!
games.summary: Super Punch-Out!! is a sports-action game released by Nintendo in 1984. The main character participates in heated 3-minute matches against world-class fighters. With the same dual-screen punching action from prequel, and the new "Ducking" defense move, you could feel that you are actually on the boxing ring even more.

games.title: Arcade Archives: Urban Champion
games.summary: Urban Champion is a beat 'em up fighting game, first released by Nintendo in 1984. True to its namesake, fighting men duke it out, fist to fist, for the title of Urban Champion! Go into battle with light and heavy punches, as well as dodging and other defensive maneuvers. Take on a 2 player battle, and try to read your opponents' moves to become the victor!

games.title: Arcade Archives: Vs. Balloon Fight
games.summary: Vs. Balloon Fight is an action game released by Nintendo in 1984. This game features uniquely floaty controls. Two players can play thrilling balloon popping battles simultaneously. Will you help out or butt in? You'll have fun doing either!

games.title: Arcade Archives: Vs. Baseball
games.summary: Vs. Baseball is a sports game released by Nintendo in 1984. Capturing the very essence of what makes baseball fun, the game has influenced many other baseball games made since. While somewhat simple, the game boasts many features such as pitch selection and base stealing.

games.title: Arcade Archives: Vs. Mahjong
games.summary: Vs. Mahjong is a 2-player Mahjong game released by Nintendo in 1984. Practice against the computer with 1-player mode or play against friends and family with 2-player mode. Think whether to make complex Mahjong hand or reliable Mahjong hand and experience the real pleasure of Mahjong!

games.title: Arcade Archives: Vs. Super Mario Bros.
games.summary: Vs. Super Mario Bros. is an action game released in 1986 by Nintendo. Mario and Luigi must go on a widespread adventure in order to rescue Peach from the clutches of Bowser. This version is from the Nintendo Vs. System, and the positions of enemies and items differ from the Nintendo Entertainment System (NES) version.

games.title: Arcade Archives: vs. Tennis

games.title: Arcade Archives: Vs. Wrecking Crew

games.summary:
Peter Pepper's Burger is the hottest grill in town, thanks to its classic menu of award-winning puzzles and patties. But when retro gaming's master chef can't take the heat of inventing a brand-new burger, the ingredients that got chopped from Chef Peter Pepper's latest recipe take matters into their own comically oversized gloves.

Out of the trash can leap four nefarious Food Foes, edible enemies with an appetite for revenge! In the ultimate battle of man vs. food, will cook or cuisine reign supreme?

In 1982, Chef Peter Pepper and the Food Foes delighted arcade-goers worldwide with the action/puzzler BurgerTime. The classic gameplay returns in a fresh, colorful package full of tasty twists and scrumptious surprises as BurgerTime Party! for the Nintendo Switch system! Iron-willed chefs can individually tackle the solo campaign or join up to three friends in local multiplayer, either by working cooperatively to defeat the Food Foes together, or by taking control of one or more Food Foes to stop the other team's chef(s) from completing their culinary masterpieces. games.title: Burn! SuperTrucks
games.summary: The championship regulations in the ¬´ SuperTrucks ¬ª mode require you to get over large metal ramps at different strategic points, where control and anticipation in each jump are essential to ranking among the best drivers. Compete in championship mode on different tracks, located and designed throughout the entire USA. Drive from north to south, from the coast to the highest peaks. Win the gold cup and raise it over your head at each of them. Any experienced driver can mess up and cause an accident. But don't worry! because you have the option ¬´ flashback ¬ª, which turns back the clock to just before the accident for a new chance, and it's all done in slow motion (bullet time). With several weather settings, each race will always feel different at all times. In training mode, you can practice on an oval circuit with the vehicles that have already been unlocked. Get the best times in the time trial mode and upload them to the world ranking. The challenge is to be number 1 on the world podium among your colleagues, friends or family. Burn! SuperTrucks offers you a passionate and extreme driving experience, with incredible skids and dizzying jumps, where your adrenaline will be through the roof at all times. But don't forget! You yourself are your worst rival.

Engulfed in sadness, she fell asleep one night whilst hugging the blade her brother disemboweled himself with.

Suddenly, a deity calling itself Byakko appeared in her dreams—

Byakko informed her that Aizu will eventually lose the war, and bestowed upon her a single mission:

"With this gun, please prevent the 'Tragedy of the Youth' from ever taking place.
If you are able to accomplish this, I shall grant any wish of yours on the following dawn."

When she awoke, her brother's blade had changed into a gun—

Three years later, the protagonist, who had become an expert in artillery, was led to meet with her comrades-in-arms, whom she will share her fate with.

Will the ending they reach be one of tragedy, glory, or perhaps...

—This is a story of the fight against a tragic history.

In this bundle you will find: TIC-TAC-TOE (also known as Noughts and Crosses, or Xs and Os) Two players alternate placing Xs and Os onto the grid. The first player to create a straight line of three of his or her symbols... wins! CHECKERS (also known as Draughts) Players move their pieces diagonally from one square to another square. When a player jumps over their opponent's piece, you take that piece from the board. The first player to lose all of his or her pieces loses the game. MEMORY GAME The objective of the game is to clear a rectangular board covered with cards faced down with minimum number of moves. Each separate move is to turn over any two cards. If they match you take them from board, if not you turn them back over. MINES The objective of the game is to clear a rectangular board containing hidden "mines" without detonating any of them. Numbers on revealed squares show how many mines are adjacent to that square. GOMOKU Two players alternate placing white and black tokens onto the grid. The first player to create a straight line of five of his or her stones... wins!

games.summary:
This is an action-adventure game released by Bothtec in 1986. The main character is drifting as a spirit in the ruins that suddenly appear from under the sea. There is no explanation as to why he has become a spirit or what he has to do, but by exploring the ruins, the situation becomes dimly apparent.

One of the highlights of this game is the spirit ride system, in which the player possesses a defeated opponent. The attack methods and durability vary depending on the possessed body, so the key to the strategy is which creature you possess as you continue your search. In addition, the items that can be obtained change depending on the player's actions, and the storyline and ending change, so it is up to the player to decide how to proceed with the exploration of the ruins. The ability to experiment with this and that is a unique aspect of this game.

The cinematic elements of the game, such as the rich sci-fi character designs, the profound movements of the humanoid characters, and the effective sound of the waves, will add to the excitement of the game. The opening and ending music was composed by Crystal King, which was a big hit at the time.

games.title: Eggconsole Thexder PC-8801mkIISR
games.summary:
When discussing retro robot-themed games, one masterpiece that always comes to mind is 'THEXDER'. This action-shooting game was released in 1985.

The player takes control of the hyper dual-armor "THEXDER," which can transform into both robot and fighter forms, and throws himself into the battle to destroy the magnetic field generator of the asteroid Nediam. The game is played in side-view and consists of 16 stages (plus 16 back stages).

In the battle against the enemy, you can use either the robot form, which has a tracking laser but inferior mobility, or the fighter form, which can only attack in the direction you are going but has superior mobility, depending on the situation. Barriers are also available, but if they are used too often, they will run out of energy, so they should be used only when the situation calls for it! You should use them only when you need them.

The game is based on the life system with no save function, so you only have one shot each time you play! The difficulty level of the game is high, so if you are good at it, please give it a try.

This is a masterpiece that has been carefully crafted with a world view, excellent mecha design, and smooth animation during transformation, not to mention the addictive nature that makes you want to play it over and over again despite its difficulty.

games.summary:
A monster title that recorded sales of 400,000 copies in the Japanese PC game market. When talking about the history of RPGs, you can’t leave this one out - it’s a must-play!

A side-view action RPG released by Nihon Falcom in 1985, the player takes on the role of an adventurer to explore a total of 10 stages and ultimately defeat the King Dragon. Stores are placed on the map and monsters roam the streets, but monsters are finite and cease to appear once they are hunted down.

Combat uses a symbol-encounting system. When you come in contact with an enemy, the battle scene switches to the battlefield, where you fight using weapon attacks (body blows) and magic. Treasure chests appear when enemies are defeated, and items and money can be acquired.

In this game, the player character does not have a profession, but has two types of experience and levels: warrior and wizard, and can grow into either a warrior or wizard type depending on which type of character is used to defeat enemies. Weapons, armor, and magic also have experience values, and using the same items can result in increased effectiveness.

With domestic sales of 400,000 units (Japan), this PC game from the 1980s still holds a record that remains unbroken. It's difficult to find another title that truly embodies the term 'epoch-making' as well as this one!

This is an action game released by Bothtec in 1984. Venture forth with explosive fireballs as your weapon! Join the Yokai detective on a mission to rescue Sayuri, who has been abducted by monsters.

The player controls the monster detective and engage in battles to rescue Sayuri, who has been lured by a group of monsters.

The unique feature of this game is the distinctive attack method. The fireballs can not only be launched but also freely controlled and detonated. However, since the fireballs are linked to the movement of the player's character, it may be challenging until you get used to it.

Being caught in the blast of a fireball will also knock down your character, so understanding the stage layout and enemy placements is crucial. Controlling the fireballs becomes a key strategy.

games.summary:
This is an action RPG released by Nihon Falcom in 1987. The landmark first game of an ongoing popular title. Master the 'half-character shift' and embark on an adventure in the land of Esteria!

Players take on the role of Adol Christin, a red-haired adventurer, as he embarks on a journey to seek the six Books of Ys.

At the time of its release, the PC gaming industry was saturated with challenging RPGs. However, Nihon Falcom took a different approach with this game, releasing it with the concept of ""Now, it's the era to bring kindness in RPGs,"" aiming to create an RPG that everyone could enjoy.

The game features clever level-up settings that eliminate the hassle of grinding for experience points, the removal of unreasonable traps, and agile characters that move smoothly. With numerous thoughtful design choices, the game can be enjoyed comfortably, and it is not an exaggeration to say that it is filled with ""kindness,"" as the tagline suggests.

The small and detailed hidden object pictures that challenge children to find certain items. They have been proven to promote children's perception and language progression. Farmquest can be played by children of any age. Thanks to the voice output, even toddlers are able to explore the hidden object pictures on their own. They do not need to be able to read to have a sense of achievement. Concentration and attentiveness are taught in a playful way. Incidentally, a study conducted by the Singapore Technological University proved the fact that hidden object games increase the understanding of spatial perception in memory. In addition, visual search skills were noticeably improved. The game can also be used to support language learning. Simply select the desired language in the settings and start playing. What are you waiting for?

games.title: G-Mode Archives 02: Ai to Roudou no Hibi
games.summary: Ai to Roudou no Hibi is a surreal mobile life simulation game where the player takes control of a bear as they get a job and live out their short 31 day life. The bears job consists of rolling a ball to a goal, avoiding holes and obstacles. Failing to do so results in some strong words their boss and a cut to their wages.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 03: Kururin Cafe
games.summary:
Set in a cafe, this is a cute puzzle game where you rotate the cursor to connect and erase 3 or more blocks of the same pattern. Look at the customer's order, erase the block shown on the menu, and clear the screen as you advance in the different levels. Let's satisfy the customers while aiming for a big chain!

There are three modes available: "Kururin mode" where the player must complete orders within the time limit, "Challenge mode" a vs. 2-player mode, and "Tokon mode" to play endlessly without a time limit.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 04: Beach Volleyball Girl Shizuku
games.summary: This two-on-two beach volleyball game has players competing to be the best team possible.The core game is action-based, with a relatively fast pace and special over-the-top super moves for each character. Players can either play in a story mode, where they follow protagonist Shizuku's beach volleyball career, or practice matches against the CPU in a versus mode. A collection mode also lets players dress up the characters in the various swimsuits they've collected.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 05: Sukebooo Man
games.summary: This side-scrolling extreme sports game puts a side-scrolling spin on the skateboarding craze of the 2000s. Players jump their way through 2D platforming levels, complete with bottomless pits and floating platforms, while collecting burgers. Instead of running through like in a traditional platformer, though, they skate their way through. Players can perform various tricks while flying through the air, racking up points by doing tricks and combos. Players compete for high scores on each level, balancing collecting burgers and performing complex series of tricks to maximize their score.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 06: Shijou Saikyou Miyamoto Julia
games.summary: 50 years after the end of the Galactic War, the eastern galaxy's bubble economy finally pops. The resulting depression catapults society into a desperate age of class stratification, with workers at the bottom struggling to make ends meet. Julia Miyamoto, the player character, is a temp worker doing her best to get by in the bad economy. She takes a gig at the Galaxy Crisis Management Organization, where she discovers that she has an incredible talent for cleaning up other people's messes, and sets out to prove herself. In the process, she'll find herself drawn into a galaxy-wide conspiracy. This mission-based action RPG has players setting out to clear missions by wiping out waves of enemies as efficiently as possible.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 07: Love Love Knuckle
games.summary: Love Love Knuckle is a goofy beat-em-up starring buff men wearing animal heads. Players use their buff animal man to beat up other buff animal men and collect the high-calorie sweets they drop to recover health. In between battles, players can buy upgrades to customize their character, including new heads.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 08: Pucchin Puzzle
games.summary: Pucchin Puzzle provides a variation on the nonogram puzzle genre. Players control a square-shaped dog on a grid; players need to mark specific squares in the grid to reveal pixel-art pictures, following hints on the top and left sides of the screen. The game's puzzles are divided into many different themed worlds, laid out on a world map, with different graphical styles and different costumes for the main characters in each different world.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 10: Souhide Series Omatsuri-zukushi
games.summary:
Let's go out for various fairs every season!
A collection of festival mini-games full of nostalgia!

You can enjoy a variety of games such as the festival's classic "goldfish scooping" and "shooting", as well as "smart ball" and "ring throwing" as much as you want.
There are games that can be played other than opening stores, such as "Bon Dancing" at the summer festival and "Mochitsuki" at the spring festival. Let's explore every corner of the shrine throughout the year and play all 10 kinds of mini-games.

The memories of the player playing are written in a diary. I enjoyed shooting... I ate a lot of yakisoba... Let's write a lot of your own thoughts in your diary.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 11: Senbazuru
games.summary:
A horror adventure novel that stimulates the imagination.
What do you pray for with a thousand cranes?

Senbazuru is generally known to be folded for "prayer". However, it is said that it has the aspect of a kind of obsession and a desperate wish...

The main character "Yuichi Sasaki" is an ordinary 26-year-old office worker. One morning, Yuichi receives a call from a hospital called Tsukumo General Hospital, which he had never heard of.

It seems that his lover Mayuri was transported the night before. He hurried to Tsukumo General Hospital, but...

A scenario where you can't predict what happens next, a branching system with "cards" that determines the future of the story.

Let's complete various stories surrounding Yuichi and Mayuri.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 12: Night Hike
games.summary:
Night Hike is the second entry in the Senbazuru, or Thousand Paper Cranes, series. In the darkness, an unknown fear attacks you.

"Night Hike'' is an outdoor program that increases people's tolerance for darkness, senses they don't normally use, and a sense of solidarity with others by walking on mountain trails at night without lights.

Keita Iizuka, a budding reporter, is drawn to the unfamiliar term "night hike" and joins an outdoor tour in a deserted camp on the outskirts of the Tokyo metropolitan area.

Scenarios branch through a "choice card" system. An immersive sound production stirs your imagination. In the darkness filled with anxiety and fear, will you be able to welcome the morning again?

games.title: G-Mode Archives 13: Rinji Shuuden
games.summary:
The third entry in the Senbazuru series. A strange event that attacks a passenger on a mysterious train...

"No... I remember seeing the last train running leaving me behind.

After that... That's right... The next train of the last train came into the platform. On the destination panel ... it said "Temporary last train."

A few passengers boarded the last train on a certain line at midnight. The scenery wrapped in darkness. A strange unmanned station. Hydrangea flowers that emerge on the night after the rain in early summer.

The mysterious atmosphere and the fear of not being able to reach the original world are there...

The third game of the Senbazuru series. Can you get through this fear...!?

games.title: G-Mode Archives 14: Mystia
games.summary:
In order to save the village crisis, the magical swordsman Meena leaves. An easy-to-play adventure fantasy that everyone wanted.

The first installment of the adventure fantasy RPG "mystia" series set on the Mystia continent.

Let's operate Meena, a magical swordsman, and go on an adventure while defeating monsters and searching for treasures in the field and dungeons!

The combat system is a simple command battle that pursues operability.

If you fight with 8 kinds of magical attributes in mind, no matter how strong the opponent is, you may be able to advance the battle to the advantage!

It is also equipped with a memo function that shows the next purpose and an auto save function, so you can play on the move with peace of mind.
Let's get rid of the many monsters that attack, solve the mystery, and regain the peace of the village.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 16: Beach Volleyball Girl Shizuku 2: Hishou-hen
games.summary:
Beach fairies fly to the world!
Take the victory against the world's powerhouses!

The second easy-to-use beach volleyball game in which a cheerful high school girl, Shizuku Asagiri, is active.

One year after the previous work, the "Cinderella Cup" that determines the No.1 in the country...
Shizuku and his partner Haruna will go on a world expedition and challenge powerful players from various countries.
Let's win a hot rally that unfolds with famous places around the world in the background and seize the victory!

In addition to unique characters and gorgeous swimsuits, this work introduces a "tanning system"!
Depending on the swimsuit you are wearing, you will leave healthy sunburn marks on the water.
You can enjoy the combination of swimsuit collection and sunburn marks.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 18: Hero Must Die. Director's Cut
games.summary:
An innovative RPG produced with Mr. Shoji Masuda for the original draft, scenario, and game design, Shunya Yamashita for character design, and Kenji Ito for music and gorgeous famous creators.
The hero who defeated the demon king and saved the world in exchange for his life went on a journey to find the woman he loved with five days of life expectancy. Time in the game passes according to the action, and as death approaches, the hero gradually loses his power...
A multi-scenario where you can experience new discoveries and new developments every time you play back. You can enjoy it as many times as you want due to the multi-ending where the content of the funeral changes depending on what you do before you live.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 20: Magical Fantasista
games.summary:
The first in the series of magical synthetic RPG.

In order to avoid the pinch of school withdrawal, Holin, a student of the Magic College, travels on an adventure to clear the challenges in the "Seventh Star System".

The "Seventh Star System" that Holin ventures is made of the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, and the Sun, and the inside of the dungeon changes every time you enter. At the bottom, there is a boss waiting to see through the task.

Please aim to be a "fantasista" in the magical world by developing various magical effects and skills that Holin herself has hidden, and creating powerful magic freely.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 21: Unou Paradise
games.summary:
I'm snoring in my tired right brain!
Have fun checking the power of the right brain that controls intuition and inspiration.

"Unou Paradise" is a game that fun to play and check the ability of the "right brain" that controls human intuition, inspiration, creativity, and image.

All you need for the operation is 4 buttons, up, down, left and right, and your judgment.
Check the ability of the "right brain" while doing various tasks (games) such as quickly counting the animals in the group within the time limit and instantly choosing the same picture as the example.

There are 8 types of tasks (games) included.
There is an "exam" mode through all assignments and a "practice" mode where you can play only one type of assignment.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 23: Keitai Shoujo
games.summary:
"Keitai Shoujo" is a love simulation game with the aim of making a girlfriend in about 40 days until Christmas with Lin, a girl who became a mobile phone girl.

As you live your daily school life, let's talk to girls, email and date.
At specific events, the PPM (psychedelic pink motion) system that allows you to freely appreciate girls is activated, and the reaction and favorability of girls changes depending on the point of view, and there are also factors such as being reflected in the game.

Please enjoy the pure love story with the five girls who appear.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 24: Sangokushi Nendaiki DX
games.summary:
Expand the territory and unify the world at a good pace.

A country stealing game that you can easily enjoy in the era of the Three Kingdoms!

"Sangokushi Nendaiki DX" is a country stealing simulation game set in the era of the Three Kingdoms in China, and can be enjoyed by a wide range of beginners and advanced users.

Let's expand our army's territory while moving units to empty territories and attacking enemy territories, and aim to unify the country with all 5 scenarios.

The battle is conducted by roulette, and it is a simple one that "the higher the number wins".

The more the force of the unit increases, the larger the number of roulette, and the more the battle becomes dominant.
Please command the warlords and reinforcements well and rule the turbulent world with your hands.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 25: Topolon
games.summary: TOPOLON is a futuristic action puzzle game that challenges the nano-world. Viruses have the habit of moving back and forth on wires that are strung across the circuitry. Collide and destroy viruses by attracting and splitting them up. Viruses will continue to be generated indefinitely and, if left unattended, will transform into other forms. The key to clearing a stage is the player's ability to make quick decisions and efficient operations. There are three different game modes, three difficulty levels, and a random stage generation function.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 26: Ore no Sentai Oranger

I'll make the next hero!
Become the commander of the Hero Squadron and protect the peace on Sunday morning!

"Ore no Sentai Oranger" is a training simulation game that nurtures the hero squadron.

Each of the five members of the squadron has their own personality, age and gender.
In addition to normal physical techniques, I will master "special moves" that make use of my specialty, such as a ike-face attack that shoots the hearts of moms.

The growth of the Oranger was confirmed by the battle with the enemy in the Sunday morning program and sales (children's festival).

Cultivate a squadron according to the fan base, and compete with other heroes for the popularity ranking and aim for the first place.
It's up to you how you enjoy it. Let's grow your favorite squadron!

games.title: G-Mode Archives 27: Ninja no Gakko
games.summary:
Train hard to become a full-fledged ninja!

A collection of mini games set in a ninja school.

Players become students at a three-year ninja school, improve their ninjutsu skills through various mini-game-style classes, and take on promotion exams and graduation exams.

You can play 5 types of mini-games, including ``Shuriken Throw'' where you aim at enemies that appear up, down, left and right, and ``Transformation Technique'' where you memorize frog cries in order.

As you advance to the next grade, you will be able to take new classes, and the difficulty level of the previous subjects will also increase!!

There is no limit to the number of classes you can take, so you can take any subject you like as many times as you like, and there are also elements that allow you to complete your career path after graduating from ninja school.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 29: Zanac
games.summary: Zanac is a classic shooting game that made a name for itself in the gaming industry in 1986. This mobile app version of the game recreates the original game, including hidden elements. The game system has been rearranged to make it easier to play. In addition, this title has been improved with the G-Mode archives. The "Arrange" mode allows you to fly through the air more intensely and smoothly. The game includes two modes: "Arrange" mode, which is more intense and smoother, and "Original" mode, where you can enjoy the nostalgic graphics of the time. There are eight types of special weapons. Each weapon has its own unique characteristics, and the power of each weapon increases with successive attacks. The thrill comes from the large number of bullets that the enemy attacks with. Use the special attacks to your advantage to defeat the final boss!

games.title: G-Mode Archives 30: Sorcerian
games.summary:
Action RPG "Sorcerian" that gained popularity as a game for PCs and consumers. This work is a complete port of the mobile app version of "Advanced Sorcerian". Redesigned graphics and a variety of effects will enliven your adventure in the fantasy world.

Players are free to challenge each scenario by creating a party of 4 people from 4 different classes. Each scenario has a lot of mystery-solving and maze elements, and it's very responsive.

Includes "Basic Scenario (Chapter 16)" including tutorials and G-mode original scenarios, and additional scenarios "Sengoku Sorcerian (Chapter 5)" and "Pyramid Sorcerian (Chapter 5)".

With the Sorcerians and your hands, lead a number of stories to a happy ending.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 31: Irekae IQ Crossword DX
games.summary:
Let's replace the letters and align the words!

A new sense of crossword puzzle that makes the pleasure of filling become a habit.

If you know the words that enter each square from the vertical and horizontal hints, replace the letters!

"Irekae IQ Crossword DX" is a crossword puzzle you play by replacing panels.

If multiple words are completed with a single replacement, you will get a high score!
In addition, the player's IQ level is judged according to the time required to clear and the score.
There are three types of game modes: "World Mode" that clears the stage within the time limit, "IQ Test Mode" that determines the player's IQ level, and "Free Mode" that solves problems without worrying about the time limit.

You can participate in each national ranking with your score and IQ index.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 32: Maou Company
games.summary:
The matter of hell also depends on the money!?

An RPG where the demons of the lower class aim for the heavenly world with the power of money.

It is a role-playing game that aims for the heavens with three of his friends, in order to solve the mystery of the item "Pendulum" given to him by his uncle, Loki, a lower-class demon and the main character, is a role-playing game that aims for heaven.

If you save money during the adventure, you can exchange "engagement (contract)" with ancient demons with the power of the pendulum.

You can acquire a variety of "skills" from the demons who have engaged, so let's acquire "skills" according to your purpose and advance the battle with the enemy advantageously!
Also, if you don't understand anything while playing, the explanation will be displayed with one "Navi" button, so beginners in the demon world can also enjoy it with confidence.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 33: Tetris Diamond
games.summary:
When talking about feature phone apps, you can never leave out the G-MODE version of "TETRIS".

The "TETRIS DIAMOND" version, one of the most popular versions of TETRIS, is back as a G-MODE archive!

There are 4 types of game modes included.

Starting with the normal "TETRIS mode", "DIAMOND mode" where you can get a bonus score by erasing the line with "Diamond Tetrimino", and "PUZZLE mode" that erases all lines using limited blocks. There are various rules.

In addition to familiar techniques such as "TETRISTM line erasing" and "T-SPIN", let's aim for a high score by making full use of the new technique "DIAMOND" using "Diamond Tetrimino"!

Please enjoy the glittering world of "TETRIS" that still does not fade.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 34: Majoukko Princess
games.summary:
Mefi, the princess of the devil's castle, was defeated by a hero and lost her place. Let's summon our wisdom, trap humans, and recapture the castle!

The stage of the story is after the ending of a role-playing game... Mefi, the last boss who has been kicked out of the Devil's Castle, aims to revenge on the hateful heroes!

However, there is very little that Mefi, who has lost her magical power, can do.

Let's carry the wooden box placed in the stage to make a scaffolding, and make good use of tricks such as Tsurugiyama and punching gloves to clear it.

When you get orbs and treasure chests that appear on a specific stage, you can recover your demon friends and stolen treasures, and the title screen that was alone also includes the lively elements that change more and more.

Will Mefi be able to regain the demon castle stolen by the hero!?

games.title: G-Mode Archives 35: Magical Fantasista II
games.summary:
Lost and in search of "Akashic Records" ...
The second magic synthetic RPG that fights by making use of magic and individuality!

The second installment of the magical synthetic RPG "Magical Fantasista" series.
The three honor students of the Imperial Academy of Magic, Kamui, Mercurius, and Yuturna, were involved in a big incident during the final assignment at the end of the school year and decided to go on an adventure to solve it.

The three of them are good at attribute magic, sword magic, and star magic, each of which has different characteristics, and while synthesizing the magic obtained as a trophy and taking an exam at the dojo, while raising the magic level, they face the crisis of the Nebula country. I'll go.

Dungeons where the terrain changes every time you enter, and the ability equipment system where you can enjoy a wide variety of training are also alive and well.

Enjoy the magnificent world of Magical Fantasista, where many powerful enemies are waiting!

games.title: G-Mode Archives 36: Beach Volleyball Girl Shizuku 3 - Sekai Taikai-hen
games.summary:
The shining midsummer sun stimulates the hearts of the fairies. A beach volleyball festival where 16 beautiful girls dance in the air.

This game is set in Tokyo in 2XX9, one year after the world expedition in the previous work "Flight Edition". Shizuku Asagiri, the captain of the Ao High School beach volleyball club, was practicing hard every day with his junior, Suzu Kamijima. It was a pair of Shizuku & Bells who challenged the preliminary round of the world tournament for the reunion with Shizuku's best friend Haruna, but ...?

In this work, not only new characters, but also nostalgic characters who appeared in past works will participate!
In the competition scene, new actions such as "change of operation character" and "combination technique" are also added.

In the new "World Tour Mode", you can play in pairs with your favorite characters!

Everyone's long-awaited swimsuits and sunburn have also been increased ...! Please enjoy the "Shizuku World" that has evolved more brilliantly and boldly.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 37: Moe Slot Beach no Shizuku
games.summary:
Beach fairies appear in the slot! Put out the enchanted "777" with your fingers!

"Moe Slot ☆ Beach no Shizuku" is a casino-style authentic slot game that incorporates bonus elements such as "JACK POT" and "FACTOR". During the game, "Shizuku" and "Haruna" of the "Beach Volleyball Girl Shizuku" series will appear, and the adult play will be gorgeous and lovely.

A "tutorial" mode that explains the rules in an easy-to-understand manner, which is safe even for beginners, and it can be left alone! Equipped with an "autoplay" function that keeps turning the reels automatically.

If you meet certain conditions, the number of "Haruna" costumes will increase, and you can also enjoy dressing up.

Please enjoy the pleasure of making opportunities and bonuses solid and grabbing a large amount of coins.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 38: Mystia2
games.summary:
The second adventure fantasy drawn with gentle colors. The story of the "King's Sword" left by the god of Mystia.

"mystia2" is a fantasy RPG set on the continent of Mystia, one year after the previous work "mystia".

In this work, which consists of all three chapters, the party changes for each chapter.
A large volume of scenarios around the "King's Sword" left by the gods and the "Masty Stone" that manipulates the gods
You can enjoy the world view of "mystia" drawn with gentle colors more deeply.

Like the previous work, it is equipped with convenient functions such as a memo function and an automatic save system.

There are also plenty of rushing elements such as the treasure collection system and "from the beginning as it is strong" that comes out after clearing.
Let's use a wide variety of magic and challenge ourselves to fight against monsters who block our way.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 40: Kamura - Kamigami to Chigiri Shisha
games.summary:
"Kamura - Kamigami to Chigiri Shisha" is a Japanese-style fantasy RPG that depicts a magnificent story woven by gods and humans on the stage of "The Land of the Sun".

The "God Drop" system, which allows you to use unique secret techniques by possessing the gods yourself, and the "Gogyo Aisei and Soko" system, which changes damage depending on the attributes of the gods and the attributes of enemies, etc., produce strategic battles.

There are also plenty of collection elements such as completing the picture book by meeting monsters and gods, and there are also dungeons that appear only under specific conditions.

In order to stop my brother who fell into darkness, make a contract with the eight million gods in various places and defeat the darkness with the ultimate secret technique!

games.title: G-Mode Archives 41: Izumi Jiken File Vol. 1 - Shiosai-hen
games.summary:
The mystery adventure "Izumi Jiken File" series is a mystery adventure game that "deduces the culprit" based on the situation at the crime scene and the information collected by interviewing.

The main character, "Izumi Kido", is a female editor in charge of the popular novelist "Kagamitsuki Masamune".
After chasing Kagamizuki, who abandoned the manuscript and went on a journey, Izumi arrived in Shonan, the western part of Kanagawa Prefecture.
When Izumi finds Kagamizuki and comes on him, Kagamizuki tells with a mysterious face. " Actually, there was a murder case."

The victim was a 54-year-old company officer, the scene of the incident was under the breakwater of the port, and the cause of death was a head laceration due to a fall.
From the situation at the scene, it looks like an unfortunate accident, but Kagamizuki seems to be convinced that it is a murder.

Taizumi, who took the manuscript, went to the city of Shonan to unravel the truth of the incident.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 42: Izumi Jiken File Vol. 2 - Tasogare-hen
games.summary:
Suspicious death under the cold sky. Is this a suicide, or...
The second installment of the full-scale mystery adventure series.

The mystery adventure "Izumi Jiken File" series is a mystery adventure game that "deduces the culprit" based on the situation at the crime scene and the information collected by interviewing.

The best-selling author "Kagamizuki Masamune" who always goes on a sudden trip, and the new editor "Izumi Kido" who is in charge of it.
Solving the mystery of the code left by Kagamizuki, this time Izumi arrived at Tempozan in Osaka in winter.

But there was another incident there...

A man who drank coffee with sleeping pills and froze to death leaving a suicide note under the cold sky with a temperature of -5℃.

Just before the estimated time of death, she was suddenly told a breakup story from her who was dating, and there is a motive that led to suicide, but Kagamizuki feels uncomfortable with the victim who is said to have moved to the scene of the discovery of the body without wearing a jacket.

Izumi, who took the manuscript hostage again this time, is stubborn as an editor and approaches the truth of the case.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 43: Izumi Jiken File Vol. 3 - Yujuku-hen
games.summary:
Novelist Kagamizuki Masamune was suspected of a murder case while traveling... The third installment of the full-scale mystery adventure series.

The mystery adventure "Izumi Jiken File" series is a mystery adventure game that "deduces the culprit" based on the situation at the crime scene and the information collected by interviewing.

The best-selling author "Kagamizuki Masamune" who always goes on a sudden trip, and the new editor "Izumi Kido" who is in charge of it. Three days before the deadline for the new manuscript, Izumi, who is heading to Kagamizuki's apartment, receives an email.
"It's become a big deal. I want you to help me. Please come to Kirishimayama Ryokan in Kagoshima as soon as possible."
A hot spring inn wrapped in the fresh greenery of Mt. Kirishima. There was a figure of Kagamizuki who was suspected of murder...

In the open-air bath where there was a murder case, there are employees at the entrance and "Yoshizu" around it, so it is impossible to commit the crime from the outside.

It seems that the five men who used the open-air bath were forced to wait at the inn as suspects of the incident.
At this rate, my name as a novelist will be scratched. In order to clear Kagamizuki's suspicion, Izumi challenges to solve the case.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 44: Dragon x Dragon
games.summary:
Training × blending × combat. Explore the field and raise the strongest dragon!

"DRAGON x DRAGON" is an RPG that captures with three elements: training, blending, and combat.

In order to defeat the dark dragon "Genesis" that plunged the world into chaos, the boy "Willow", a descendant of the dragon messenger, grows up with his partner dragon "Kermes".

Choose your favorite field from among the many exploration destinations and set off on an adventure.

The items that can be acquired depending on the field and the attributes of the wild dragon you live in are different, so let's go deep into the field while consulting with the remaining physical strength of "Kermes" and the items you have on hand.

The young "Kermes" returns to "1" every time you return from the search destination, but you can strengthen your basic ability by mixing the items you got in the middle of the search and giving them to "Kermes".

The effect varies depending on the material to be blended. Try a wide variety of combinations and raise them to be the strongest dragon.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 45: Chura-umi Monogatari
games.summary:
A time of peace spun by the gentle sea breeze. An Okinawa life experience for those who are tired of modern times.

Chura-umi Monogatari" is a sequel to the game "Chura-jima Kurashi" that simulates life on the southern island.

The stage of this work is a small island "Kotsubu Island" floating in the beautiful sea. The main character, who is tired of living in the city, decided to move after seeing an article on "Recruitment of Administrators of Kotsubu Island" on the Internet.

You will spend a five-day trial period on this island where calm time flows.

At "Kotsubu Island", you can deepen friendship by deepening exchanges with residents, fall in love, and enjoy various leisure (mini-games) such as "Eisa", "Yashi Fruit" and "Snorkeling".
When you finish 5 days, the ending will change depending on the favorability of the residents and the degree of achievement such as mini-games.

A time of peace spun by the gentle sea breeze. Please enjoy your own southern island life.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 46: Keitai Shoujo: Koi+Hime - Koi ni Ochita Cinderella-hime
games.summary:
Those shoes are cursed if a fake wears...? A princess romance adventure in a sound novel style.

When I woke up, I was alone in the dark wilderness. In the bag I was holding, there were dolls and glass shoes...

The main character with glass shoes is attacked by a "masked man" on the way and escapes from his life, and meets a girl.
In the house where she lives, there are girls with familiar faces...

"Mobile Phone Girl - Love + Princess - Princess Cinderella Who Fell in Love" is a love simulation "Mobile Phone Girl" Gaiden work. It is a princess-like romance adventure game in a sound novel format that incorporates romantic comedy x suspense x moe elements in the Grimm's fairy tale "Cinderella" that everyone knows.

Among the heroines, the story revolves around "Sayo Tomoe" which has a quiet and mysterious atmosphere.
The main character "Hiro Aida" is attracted to her and gets involved in a certain incident.
Please enjoy the mysterious and glamorous world that is a bit different from the brilliant youth story depicted in the previous work.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 47: 12Gems
games.summary:
The time left is only one night.
Save the world with the power hidden in 12 types of GEM.

"12GEMs" is an RPG that uses the power hidden in 12 types of GEMs (jewels) and travels while summoning partners sealed in each GEM.

The beginning of the story is the aerial castle "Ganseld" floating in the sky with the power of GEM.
The people living in Ganseld chose themselves as noble people, and the lower world on earth was taught as a place where unclean people and horrible monsters wandered around, and they lived without involvement.

However, one day, the GEM that supported Ganseld suddenly scattered to the uncurled ground.
In order to prevent the castle from falling, the main character, the boy "Dino", received the order of collecting GEM and went to the lower world, but it was a mysterious and mysterious world that was different from what was taught in Ganzeldo ...

Until Ganzeld crashed, there was only one night left. The fate of the world was entrusted to a boy.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 48: Dragon x Dragon 2
games.summary:
What is human charm? What is the truth contained in the holy flower pure bloom...

20 years after the story of DRAGON x DRAGON (Dragon x Dragon). "Seika Pure Brom" has been blooming all over the world since some time ago. The scent emitted from the petals heals people's troubles, seals the darkness that falls into the heart, and silence, innocence and "complete peace" come.

The Dark Dragon Genesis, which has reached its end, says, "In order to return to its original form, people must be released from Pure Brom someday."

The daughter of Willow, the main character of the previous work, "Adeku", embarks on a new adventure with the young dragon Lily.

Not only the characters from the previous work, but also the addition of new characters and enemy dragons has further increased the hit-in element.
Also, in this work, you can take over the level after returning from the dungeon, making it easier to play.

Adventure with the dragon and solve the mystery that sleeps in the ruins.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 51: Trio the Punch
games.summary:
"Trio the Punch" is an arcade action game released by Data East in 1990.

Players choose one of the unique characters, such as "Santos" the tough guy, "Kamakura-kun" the ninja, and "Rosesub" the swordsman.

If you defeat the enemies in the stage and get a heart, and defeat the boss who appears by collecting all the hearts, you will clear the stage.

Of course, "Mr. Chin's roulette corner" is also alive and well.
If you draw a hit, you can benefit from increasing your HP and increasing your attack power, so let's push your eyes so that you can get a more effective bonus.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 52: Burger Time
games.summary:
Drop it, swing it, and shake the pepper! The main character Peter Pepper is working hard to make hamburgers!!

"Burger Time" is an arcade game released by Data East in 1982.
This work was remade for feature phones in 2006.

Pass over the ingredients, drop them down, and complete all the hamburgers to clear the stage!

Avoid wieners and pickles that interfere with the completion of hamburgers by dropping them with the ingredients or interfering them. If you use pepper, you can temporarily stop.

Also, if you complete a new hamburger during the game, it will be added to the menu list.
Make various kinds of hamburgers, complete the menu list, and aim to clear all with a high score.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 53: Daienkai Buchou
games.summary:
Aim to be the biggest banquet manager in Japan!! Let's liven up the banquet with partitions and care!

"Daienkai Buchou" is a collection of mini-games based on the motif of Japanese salaryman culture "Banquet".

Let's play unique and varied mini-games to liven up various banquets such as year-end parties, New Year's parties, cherry blossom viewing, barbecues, etc., and improve the skills of the secretary!
In addition to "Drinkers" who pour beer into the mug, "Sashi-turning" to help with entertainment, etc., all 9 types of mini-games full of seasonal feeling such as "Cherry Blossom Viewing", "Nagashi Somen" and "Fireworks Festival".

Also, let's collect bingo prizes with bingo tickets that you can get when you get a high score.
Depending on the degree of collection of prizes and the score of the game, the title of banquet manager will be increased! Please aim for the ultimate title!

games.title: G-Mode Archives 56: Mystia3
games.summary:
The culmination of the Mystia saga, Mystia 3 acts as a prequel to the previous two games and explores the backstory of the King's Sword artifact at the centre of Mystia 2's plot. It follows Vimal and Gauri, the parents of Mystia's Mina, who are asked by the king of North Mystia to retrieve the King's Sword and use it to defeat the Demon King who threatens all of Mystia. Their story unfolds over the course of five chapters in a journey much longer than the previous two games.

This entry features significantly enhanced systems compared to previous games in the series, with a new vertically-scrolling battlefield that spans both the land and the sky. The new game plus feature from the previous game returns as well, offering players new opportunities to try things after completing the game once. This game also introduces detailed event graphics in key story scenes.

games.title: G-Mode Archives 58: Gekidan Musume Akane & Aoi
games.summary: This compilation contains ports of two separate mobile games: Gekidan Musume: Akane and Gekidan Musume: Aoi. Both games are overhead sci-fi shooters with 3D graphics in which players shoot through a series of stages; those stages and enemies are shared between the two games, while each features a different playable character and a different storyline.

games.title: G-Mode Archives+: Burari Sekai Untei
games.summary:
Because there is untei!
Travel around the world on an endless ride.

"Burari Sekai Untei" is an endless one-touch action game where you simply advance through the untei surrounding the earth.

The basic operation is just to press the button and move forward.

However, on the way, the Untei's bar may come off, or someone walking on it may step on it, so hold down the button to extend your arm, and use the 1st and 2nd jumps to avoid it.

As the stage progresses, the scenery changes and the screen scrolling speed increases.
My first goal is to circumnavigate the globe. However, you can continue the Untei journey even after completing it until you make a mistake.

Let's challenge the limits of our physical strength to see how many times we can go around the earth!

games.title: G-Mode Archives+: City Connection Rocket
games.summary:
Agent Clarice, step on the accelerator! In order to protect the peace of the earth, fly to the world with your favorite car!

City Connection Rocket, which was previously released for feature phones, is a legitimate sequel to the City Connection series, one of Jaleco's signature works.

Clarice, an agent dispatched from the United Nations, boards the new Clariscar and goes on a mission to recover the super-secret documents stolen by the runaway secret society "Spiritus".

Let's find the super-classified documents hidden on the stage while handling enemy characters well by making full use of the series's annual "oil cans" and "super rockets" that can destroy the road with your body.

There are also many huge bosses such as tanks and battle helicopters, and hidden characters with Jaleco fans.
Also pay attention to the cute Clarice that is displayed when the stage is cleared!

games.title: G-Mode Archives+: Danmaku Kentei Shiken - Ketsui-Hen
games.summary:
Part of CAVE's line of mobile bullet dodging tests. Released for DoJa and J2ME mobile devices, then re-released for Nintendo Switch.

Based on the arcade game Ketsui: Kizuna Jigoku Tachi, it weaves the stages and bosses from the original into an endless boss rush. The farther a player gets, the harder the game becomes. Players are challenged to survive as long as possible while racking up a high score. Players are able to pick from the original game's ships.

When you think of CAVE's shooting games, you think of "danmaku". But how good are you really? The second installment of "Danmaku Certification Death Test" will answer that question.

This "Danmaku Certification Death Test" is a shooting game that assesses your ability to deal with danmaku by fighting opponents that get stronger with each defeat.

In this latest installment, "Ketsui Edition", the vicious weapons from "Ketsui: Kizuna Jogoku Tachi" will stand in your way.

In addition to being evaluated by rank in the game, this game also supports online rankings,
so you can further hone your skills by competing with users from all over the world.
Those heading to hell on earth, behold the essence of danmaku.

games.title: G-Mode Archives+: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai - Milky no Yabou
games.summary:
Even if you cheat, if you win you're in the right! If you lose you have to strip! Have a dreamy time exchanging tiles with beautiful girls.

This work, which was previously released on feature phones, is a side story of Jaleco's beautiful girl competition mahjong game "Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai" series.

Milky Pie, an alien in the form of a rabbit's ``Chikyu-Seifuku Project'' begins in earnest!
Seifuku... Seifuku... That means everyone's "uniform" is in danger! ?

Idol mahjong player Suchie-Pai, a self-proclaimed righteous heroine, stands up to face the shameless crisis of the earth! !

Make full use of "loading (cheating)" by consuming points and "Suchie Stick" to draw Tsumo, win the mahjong match with beautiful girls, and steal everyone's "uniform" before Milky Pie. ! !

Enjoy two-player mahjong with reward CG, online rankings, and anything goes.

games.title: G-Mode Archives+: Ketsui - Kizuna Jigoku-tachi DX
games.summary:
The bonds I have with my friends will not let go even if I fall into hell. ``New authentic shooting'' where you fight with determination in your heart.

The year is 2054. Behind the endless wars is a company called ``EVAC Industry'' that exports weapons all over the world. The United Nations begins negotiations with EI, but EI completely rejects the proposal for a ``total ban on arms imports and exports.''
With no progress being made, the United Nations abandoned negotiations and secretly decided to intervene with force.

The mission is to ``destroy EI's weapons and development facilities'' and ``destroy everything related to UN military intervention.'' Even if the operation is successful, they will not be allowed to return home alive. There were four young people who volunteered for this harsh special mission.

Select an aircraft from two types of teams: TYPE-A (WAY SHOT type) and TYPE-B (LINEAR SHOT type). Normal bullets, lock shots, and bombs. Make full use of 3 types of attack methods and overwhelm the hell of barrage and weapons.

Also supports online rankings for each difficulty level. Take on the world with determination in your chest, even if you're willing to die.

games.title: G-Mode Archives+: Maou ga Ochiru Hi
games.summary:
Until the final boss “Demon King” comes…minimum 5 minutes! ? Form the strongest party with your friends and intercept the Demon King!

“The Day the Demon King Falls” is an easy-to-use RPG that allows you to reach the ending in as little as 5 minutes.

According to the prophecy of the great god Odin, there is only one year left until the final boss, the Demon King, appears.

Grow your hero through training and adventures within a limited amount of time, and prepare for the coming demon lord.

Don't worry, the main character has 15 friends with unique personalities.

Depending on which characters you raise as your companions, your strategy and tactics in battle will change dramatically, and over 100 different events will occur in various locations such as training grounds and adventure grounds.

From events centered around friendship, love, and hate to events that are a bit more sexy, you'll be sure to discover new things every time you play.
And once you get into it, you'll discover the true secret hidden in the "Demon King"...

games.title: G-Mode Archives+: Mikuni Field Combat
games.summary:
Near-future weapons hit the world of the Three Kingdoms!
Capture famous heroes and great heroes and invade the world of war!

Released for feature phones in 2007, "Mikuni Field Combat" is a spin-off of Jaleco's shooter game "Field Combat," released for arcades and the Family Computer in 1985.

"Field Combat" is a strategic shooter game in which you control the futuristic UFO-type attack aircraft carrier "Genesis-3" and capture enemy units with a capture beam to use them as allies while trying to clear stages.
For some reason, this futuristic weapon, the "Genesis-3," is storming into the world of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" at the end of the 2nd century!

The system of capturing enemies with a capture beam and using them as allies remains the same, but more than 130 popular generals familiar to fans of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms appear!

Recruit your favorite generals to your side and survive the wars of mainland China, where intrigue is rife!

Operate the futuristic UFO-type attack aircraft carrier "Genesis-3", defeat enemy infantry and obstacles, recruit your favorite generals as your allies, and aim to conquer the stage! Can you survive the wars of mainland China, where political intrigue is swirling?

Capture enemy generals and make them your allies. Use the capture beam to capture enemies and make them your allies! More than 130 popular generals familiar to fans of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms appear!

Use your allies' unique strategies to gain an advantage in battle!
Each captured general has a strategy (special move) that will help you. Figure out when to use it and advance the battle more advantageously!

Operate the attack mobile aircraft carrier Genesis-3 to occupy the enemy castle at the top of the map. Damage the boss enemy, who is always present on each side, and defeat, capture, or force them to retreat, and the castle gate will open. Enter the castle gate that Genesis-3 opens to proceed to the next stage.

Also, if you damage famous generals, including boss enemies, and weaken their remaining vitality to 30%, a "GET!" message will appear above them, and you will be able to capture them with a capture beam. You can make captured generals your allies after clearing the stage. Capture all the strong enemies and make them your allies to create your own strongest army (you can have up to 14 generals). If your ship, Genesis-3, loses its vitality or the time limit runs out, it will be destroyed and the game will be over. Allied generals who are incapacitated in battles on each stage will not be lost, and will be revived in the next stage or when you continue.

All allied generals always have one "strategy." A strategy is a powerful technique that can only be activated once per stage.
When the strategy you want to use is lit up in the bottom right of the screen, press the strategy button at the right time to change the course of the battle.
Only one strategy can be active at a time, and when a new strategy is activated, the previous one will be overwritten.
Continuous strategies last for about 30 seconds, and damage-dealing strategies have the following expected damage value: Water Strategy > Fire Strategy > Ambush Strategy.

Each general has a rarity, and is ranked in the following order: GR (Greater Rare) > R (Rare) > S (Special) > N (Normal).
The higher the rarity of a general, the less likely they are to appear randomly (as a general excluding bosses), but you can expect a higher level of ability.

But this is no problem for one of the speediest vessels in the galaxy! A cargo ship carrying priceless crystals was attacked by a pirate vessel. But this is no problem for one of the speediest vessels in the galaxy! The game is inspired by two classics, pop culture masterpieces, River Raid and Tron. A modern-day high school student is reincarnated as someone caught up in a mass murder case in a gloomy rural village of the early Showa era. With each time leap, relationships become more entangled, and murderous intent becomes inescapable. Through repetition, the village’s customs, hidden secrets, and the true culprit’s motives gradually come to light.

When the waning moon fades, will you be greeted by hope… or despair?

Copy enemies’ abilities like Sword and Ice and use them to attack and explore your surroundings! What journey awaits Kirby? Take a deep breath and get ready for an unforgettable adventure!

games.title: Kirby Fighters 2
games.summary:
Choose from a cast of Kirby's most iconic copy abilities - including the brand new Wrestler ability - and duke it out to be the last Kirby standing. Familiar friends and foes like Bandana Waddle Dee and King Dedede also make an appearance as playable characters.

Prove your pink puffball prowess and scale the tower in Story Mode! Meta Knight and King Dedede have seemingly teamed up to challenge Kirby to a buddy gauntlet! Fight alongside a buddy (player or computer controlled) to scale the tower, choosing helpful items between each round that will power you up for the rest of your ascent.

Each of the playable abilities and characters has a distinct play style and set of moves. Abilities like Cutter and Archer excel at ranged attacks, while Wrestler and Fighter like to get up close and personal! Other characters like Gooey and Bandana Waddle Dee bring a variety of moves from past Kirby games. Experiment with them all to find and master your favorite.

games.title: Logic Puzzle Collection: Sudoku, Permudoku, Nonodoku
games.summary: Logic Puzzle Collection is a puzzle game that offers three distinct styles of logic puzzles. In the Sudoku mode, the player is tasked to fill out a 9 x 9 field with numbers from 1 to 9, such that each row, each column and each 3 x 3 sub-field contains exactly one occurance of each of the numbers 1 to 9. Permudoku is a variation of the classic Sudoku puzzle, where instead of numbers, colours have to be placed on a 9 x 9 in such a way that each colour appears exactly once in each column, row and 3 x 3 sub-field. However, from the beginning, all fields are already coloured, the player's task is to swap fields around until the colours are distributed correctly. Both game modes include five different degrees of difficulty with 100 puzzles each, for a total of 1000 puzzles. Finally, In Nonodoku, it is the aim of the player to produce a pixel image using the number hints. The player is presented with a grid of white boxes. Numbers on the side and atop indicate how many boxes need to be coloured black in a row. Each number signifies one continuous line of black boxes, between the black boxes for two successive numbers, at least one space must remain white.

Math Classroom Challenge is an educational game in first person view, with the mission of solving the different random mathematical exercises proposed. To do this, you have at your disposal a water hose, with which you must water the numbers and the appropriate solutions. All this in a safe environment to learn mathematics in a fun and enjoyable way. It's also the kids version of Math Combat Challenge. Math Classroom Challenge is designed for children over the age of four. In the game the player can do several activities: learn the numbers that fly, learn how to throw the water, solve the static panels looking for the corresponding numbers, and solve the dynamic panels that appear suddenly with three solutions. Always throwing the water from the hose to the correct solution. In Math Classroom Challenge there are two types of mathematical panels with hundreds of math combinations: static and dynamic. The static panels propose random exercises, of configurable difficulty, whose numbers have to be searched through the stage, and bathe them with the water of the hose that we carry. Dynamic panels appear anywhere, but can be repositioned, or even invoked manually, and contain three solutions. Irrigate with water the correct solution. Dragons, on the other hand, allow an error to be subtracted, although sometimes they will cause the opposite: they will add up to an error. So the player must decide whether to use them or not. The protagonist lives with her mother in a tenement house in the Shinbashi section of the Imperial capital. Having lost her father in an accident, she works to make a living to support her sickly mother.

At the shrine she visits every day, the 16-year-old protagonist hears an unfamiliar term.

"I wish we can ask help from the Ryuuseigumi…"

Her daily life continues. She continues to live in poverty, just barely able to afford her mother's medicine. She imagined how the life of the women in western clothes that often passed by on rickshaws are like.

(Evening balls, where women in western clothes and men dance together… sure sounds nice…)

Then one day after she returned home from work, she received a set of clothes from an unknown sender. It came with a letter with just one line: "Wear this and attend the next Sairyoku House’s evening ball."

After some hesitation, the protagonist decided to wear clothes and attend the evening ball. Her lack of dance experience, the unfamiliar clothing, and the overwhelming building made her very nervous—.

"…Don’t you want to know the truth about your father’s death?"

A mysterious man said to her from behind, but when she turned around, no one was there.

After returning to the tenement house, she asked her mother about her father's death, only to discover a surprising truth. To uncover the mystery of her father's death and fulfill his wish, the protagonist and her allies rise to action—!

Drive your mountain bike through paths and hurdles over beautifull hills and amazing mountains. It is a very addictive, simple 2D game, yet challenging to play. Use the left control stick to lean back or forward and the right control stick to speed up and slow down. Make stunts, run through jumps and flips, lean back on a rear wheel drive while browsing the 42 challenging levels available now. Go uphill or downhill on glaciers in the mountains and dangerous slopes with obstacles like tree trunks and rocks. Discover extreme sensations on a half pipe or pyramid in a snow resort to achieve the best time. games.title: Piczle Colors

Piczle Colors isn't your typical grid-based color logic-puzzle! Like other puzzles of this type, hints next to each row and above each column tell you how many blocks of each color go in each row or column. By following these hints you can paint each part of the grid and reveal an image. However, these hints do NOT tell you the order they come in!

Smaller puzzles ease you into this new way of thinking. You can work your way through 6 levels with 50 puzzles each, ranging in size from 5x5 to 15x10. Each puzzle lets you start with a randomly cleared row and column if you need a helping hand, but clearing puzzles without using hints earns you coins, which you can use to unlock Piczle Colors' many cool extra features!

Piczle Pattern Turn every square in a grid black following a cross pattern. Start with a blank slate and record your fewest moves, or start from a randomly generated grid. Piczle Loops 72 logic-puzzles that require you to draw an uninterrupted looping line on a grid following the clues. Game A offers 36 puzzles from easy to moderatem, Game B another 36 from moderate to hard. Lovingly unbox your games. Take a close look at every nook and cranny of the devices, the packaging and the included materials. Read the manual, like in the good old days! Don't press on the glass, it might damage the liquid crystal! Use the controllers or press the buttons using touch-screen. The Piczle Puzzle & Watch Collection provides a nostalgic experience and hours of logic-puzzling fun.

games.title: Pokémon Brilliant Diamond
games.summary:
Revisit the Sinnoh region and the story of the Pokémon Diamond Version game
Experience the nostalgic story from the Pokémon Diamond Version game in a reimagined adventure, Pokémon Brilliant Diamond, now on the Nintendo Switch system! Adventures in the Pokémon Brilliant Diamond game will take place in the familiar Sinnoh region. Rich in nature and with mighty Mount Coronet at its heart, Sinnoh is a land of many myths passed down through the ages. You’ll choose either Turtwig, Chimchar, or Piplup to be your first partner Pokémon and then set off on your journey to become the Champion of the Pokémon League. Along the way, you’ll be able to encounter the Legendary Pokémon Dialga.

games.title: Pokémon Legends: Arceus
games.summary:

games.title: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX
games.summary:
